syllabusSource.title: PDEU course handout 2024-25 (CIVIL semester 1): Introduction to Computer Programming -I Laboratory (For ME, CL, CH, BT)
syllabusSource.note: Units and topics copied from the course handout PDF (pages 9 of CIVIL/sem1/Civil_Semester_1_Course_Handout.pdf). New in Prism: no curated sources or checked lessons yet.

topics.name: Introduction to Computer Programming: Compilation process of a C program, program execution flow, Tokens, variables, keywords and identifiers.
Simple and formatted Input Output Operations: Data types, Operators, Input /output statements in C, Formatted I/O, format specifiers, escaper sequences
Decision making and branching: if, if-else, if-else ladder, nested if, Switch, go to statement, conditional operator statement
Looping control structures: while, do-while, for loop, Break statement, Continue statement
Basics of modular programming: Introduction to modular programming through basic function syntax, introduction to header file creation, difference between #include <filename> and #include “filename”
Array and Strings: One dimensional and multidimensional array, Declaration, initialization, Array Manipulations. Matrix operations,
Introduction to Pointers: Pointer declaration and initialization, Pointer operators, Arithmetic operations using pointer.
Structure and Union: Structure, Arrays and structures, structures and functions, pointer to structure, selfreferential structures, typedef, unions
Functions: Introduction to user defined functions, Types of Functions, Call by value, Call by reference
File Handling in C: File handling in C, Different types of files, Operations on Files, File handling functions.
